Title: Advances in Large Language Models

Abstract: Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language processing. Key innovations include the transformer architecture, which enables parallel processing of sequential data, and self-attention mechanisms that allow models to weigh the importance of different parts of the input. Training these models requires massive datasets and computational resources. Models like GPT-3 and BERT have demonstrated remarkable performance across various NLP tasks, including translation, summarization, and question answering. However, challenges remain in areas such as factual accuracy, bias mitigation, and computational efficiency.

Question:
queries: What architecture do modern LLMs use?
What are the main innovations in LLMs?
